verdict.rationale: jo is confirmed to ship a native macOS app (jo-docs-11, jo-probe-rt-1) alongside cloud/chat surfaces, satisfying the 'official desktop app' part, but there is no evidence of OS-level keyboard shortcuts or screen-content access/capture capability anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: documentation of global/OS-level shortcuts, evidence of screen reading/capture functionality, any hands-on confirmation of these features.
